description: Live E2E for the Tilemap RQL module. Driven by tests/e2e/run_tool_e2e.py (scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (adapter, validation, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node2D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema proves the module was discovered (its adapter description). The 'tools' then run every TilemapGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-backs and a rejected call that must fail before it changes anything. res://e2e-tileset.tres is the testbed's empty TileSet fixture (a cell keeps its source / atlas ids even when the TileSet has no such source). 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated.

input.query: nodes | where name == "Layer" | get usedCells | select x y sourceId atlasX atlasY alternative
nodes | where $ is TileMapLayer | select name usedCellCount TileSet
nodes | where name == "Layer" | select usedCellCount TileSet

expect: sourceId must be a TileSet source id of at least 0
